services.name: Kids Karate
services.desc: Fitness, focus, and fun-all in one class. Our younger kids’ classes provide a foundation in traditional Karate techniques such as punches, kicks, and blocks, along with an introduction to Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu concepts including sweeps, escapes, and positions. Self-control, strength, safe partner work, and body awareness are emphasized. Each class ends with an obstacle course or skill stations that reinforce development. Our older kids’ classes emphasize both physical and mental development. Children learn traditional Karate techniques, katas, and strengthening exercises.
